I have farmed for many years without school, so I follow what the extension worker and my neighbors do. On this half-hectare of maize, I will apply some DAP and urea fertilizer from the cooperative, along with manure from my cattle, because maize needs strength to grow. I will use improved seed since I saw it gives a better yield, but I will not waste money on pesticides or irrigation when the rains come. My family will work this plot ourselves, about fifty days over the season, and we will not hire outside labor.
